notes: UDP stopped switching itself off on forwarded ports: the five-second DHCP discovery pass rebuilt a client's forwarding rows from metadata it does not carry, and empty was read as "no port wants UDP". Rotating a PPPoE session no longer leaves the router without internet -- the ip-up hook runs as a separate process and was opening the wrong database, so it never set the session's route or re-applied nftables (a 0.4.87 regression). Every duplicated PPPoE session now gets its own MAC, not just Viettel ones, and sessions duplicated earlier are repaired at boot; the MAC can be edited by double-clicking it, with duplicates refused. New: install a zip or an ISO picked from your own PC, for a router that cannot reach the internet. The Internet tab refreshes the card or panel that changed instead of reloading the whole page.
